# Samuel David Arenas Pareja — Senior Software Engineer

## Professional Summary
Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of production experience specializing in scalable web applications, distributed microservices, and cloud architectures. Currently building core platform surfaces at Procore (Hubs team) via FullStack Labs, shipping high-impact features across React, Next.js, Ruby on Rails (Cornerstone monolith), and AWS. Proven track record leading authorization migrations, high-scale event streaming with Apache Kafka, micro-frontend (MFE) modularization, and WCAG 2.1 accessibility compliance.

## Professional Experience

### FullStack Labs (Remote, USA Contractor)
**Client:** Procore Technologies | **Team:** Hubs Team
- **Senior Software Engineer — Hubs** (April 2024 – Present)
- **Mid-Level Software Engineer** (January 2022 – April 2024)

**Context:** Building the company and project home across the hubs microservice, the hubs UI, and the Cornerstone monolith. Covers authorization for personal and published views, card-library visibility, LaunchDarkly feature flags, portfolio/home settings, analytics, and API performance.

**Key Contributions:**
1. **Authorization & Permissions Migration:** Migrated permissions client from full permissions manifest to Cornerstone’s domain operations API, enabling fast checks for named actions (view hubs, manage personal views, publish views, manage containers) and staying within strict latency targets for view and container routes.
2. **Micro-frontends & Web Apps:** Architected company and project home pages using React, Next.js, and micro-frontend patterns for high modularity and uptime.
3. **Event Streaming:** Implemented asynchronous event pipelines using Apache Kafka (Outbox pattern and Kafka Connect) across Onboarding and Hubs services to guarantee event consistency.
4. **Accessibility (a11y):** Authored 20+ keyboard navigation, ARIA role, and screen-reader accessibility fixes aligning strictly with WCAG 2.1 standards.
5. **Entitlements & Onboarding:** Implemented entitlement management and sandbox onboarding solutions using Node.js and DynamoDB.
6. **Testing & Quality:** Maintained high test coverage with unit/integration test suites using Jest and React Testing Library.
7. **AI Innovation:** Collaborated on an award-winning AI agent during an internal hackathon in 2025, utilizing Python, AWS, and OpenAI APIs.
